scenarios.title: Project clarification
scenarios.receivedEmail: Before we finalize the plan, could you clarify which teams are included, who approves the draft, and whether testing depends on that approval?
scenarios.starterDraft: The plan covers the service team. Maya is the approver. Testing can start after approval. I have not confirmed the approval date. Could you confirm whether you need any additional details?

scenarios.title: Purchase decision
scenarios.receivedEmail: Please choose a supplier and confirm the next step for the purchase.
scenarios.starterDraft: I recommend supplier B at $450. This is a recommendation, not purchase approval. Please approve the choice by December 4 so we can request the order.

scenarios.title: Team support
scenarios.receivedEmail: The schedule change has been difficult for the team. Could we discuss ways to share the workload without overloading anyone?
scenarios.starterDraft: I understand the schedule change has been difficult. I can review the workload with you on December 4. I cannot cover additional shifts this week. Could we discuss the available options together?

scenarios.title: A creative proposal
